title: AUD-002: Interview Coach act() Warning Elimination - Zero Console Noise in Test Pyramid
spec: Objective: Reproduce and eliminate the React act(...) warnings in tests/interview-coach-lifecycle.test.mjs (timer ticks + CBT palette updates in DashboardInterviews.jsx). Root cause expected: async event-loop dispatches outside act(). Fix: wrap timer advancements in act() and ensure mock audio cleanup on unmount. plan.summary: Reproduced: 21 act() warnings in lifecycle test (20x DashboardInterviews in two ~1s-spaced burst clusters at the step-17/step-18 remounts + 1x Root at final unmount). Root causes: (1) stubPlugin stubs src/firestore/dbOperations but DashboardInterviews imports getResumes from src/services/api/platform, so the real async fetch chain runs against the mocked fetch and its setResumes continuation resolves outside act() after each remount, cascading ~10 outside-act updates per mount; (2) per-second TICK/AiGenerationProcessingModal interval ticks that fire in real-time gaps outside act(); (3) final reactRoot.unmount() invoked via bare setTimeout(0) outside act(). Fix is test-side only (zero production changes): mirror the proven clean harness pattern from live-interview-ui.test.mjs.
steps: 1. Add missing src/services/api/platform stub to stubPlugin (getResumes = async () => ({ resumes: [] })) so remount async continuations resolve inside act
2. Add advanceTimers(ms) helper routing ALL real-time waits through act() (macrotask flush) and replace bare microtask flushes after mounts/clicks
3. Move final unmount inside act() (render div + unmount) eliminating the Root warning
4. Deterministically absorb interval ticks: advanceTimers(1050) inside act at exam-phase entry so the 1000ms TICK lands inside act
5. Gates: node --test lifecycle = 0 act warnings, npm run test:interview (all 4 files) = 0 act warnings + exit 0, npm run build exit 0, git diff frozen files = 0
6. Capture evidence log and submit via bridge dev submit-evidence
